summary: Inspected current implementation and the untracked policy tests. TypeScript verification passed with --noEmit; the supplied full-suite pass was not independently rerun under read-only constraints. One requirement gap remains.

findings.message: Preserve Claude's error details when a requested model fails in a JSON error envelope.
findings.evidence: src/core/review/adapters/claude.ts:11 replaces all is_error/non-success envelopes with 'Claude review did not complete successfully', discarding envelope.result/errors. Consequently, runReview saves a blocked report without the reviewer's model rejection error, contrary to the unavailable-model requirement. New rejection coverage tests only Codex; Claude coverage checks only the generic failure.
findings.reason: Include the available reviewer diagnostic in the thrown error and cover a Claude model rejection envelope through the saved blocked report.
